title: Modelling the Orvan gap: assumptions matter more than the headline

facts.subject: Orvan sea routes
facts.statement: The loss on the four Orvan sea routes is at 50% to 60% of value in the fourth quarter, against the deal-level path.

source_ref.text_snippet: Our model puts the loss on the four Orvan sea routes at 50% to 60% of value in the fourth quarter, against the deal-level path.

facts.subject: rail runs
facts.statement: Rail runs are assumed to operate at 54% above the pre-crisis volume on a base of USD 25M a month.

source_ref.text_snippet: Second, we assume rail runs at its practical limit, which we put at 54% above the pre-crisis volume on a base of USD 25M a month.

facts.subject: Vanir wheat
facts.statement: Vanir wheat is assumed to gain 14% to 18% in volume on the Tolan and Midgard routes.

source_ref.text_snippet: Third, we assume Vanir wheat gains of 14% to 18% in volume on the Tolan and Midgard routes.

facts.subject: Asgard wheat contract
facts.statement: The Asgard wheat contract is assumed to have a loss of about 8%.

source_ref.text_snippet: We assume a loss of about 8%.

facts.subject: Midgard wheat
facts.statement: The net value loss for Midgard wheat is close to 40%, once Vanir supply is included.

source_ref.text_snippet: On these assumptions, the net value loss for Midgard wheat is close to 40%, once Vanir supply is included.
